semiconductor_relevance: High — Tenstorrent Japan develops and sells RISC-V-based CPU IP and specialized processors for AI, making it a significant player in the semiconductor design and intellectual property space.
summary: Tenstorrent Japan specializes in developing high-performance RISC-V-based CPU IP and chiplets, focusing on AI processing accelerators. The company offers scalable solutions including PCIe cards and server systems, along with advanced educational programs in digital SoC design.

regional_presence.Japan: Tenstorrent has a global office in Tokyo, indicating its strategic presence in the Japanese market.
